headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Christian Cage vs. Bryan Danielson fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.46 ? a real highlight of the night. Danielson and Cage clashed for the first time ever, with Danielson locking in the LeBell Lock before Ricky Starks' interfering title-belt shot let Cage steal the pin and retain.
On this day in 2023, Kris Statlander vs. Skye Blue went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.71. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

It was 2023 when the ROH World TV Title was up for grabs as Samoa Joe vs. Willie Mack went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.36. For Willie Mack, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Castagnoli & Yuta vs. Gates of Agony headlined Rampage, rated 5.83 in a hard-hitting tag team clash.
On this day in 2023, it was the first-ever encounter between 2.O & Garcia and Hardys & Zay, opening the card on Rampage, rated 4.71.
On this day in 2023, Juice Robinson vs. Christopher Daniels crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 4.93.
